title: The report that doxxed the reporter
blurb: The draft exposed reporter identity and auto-removed at 0.6 confidence.
prompt: A reporter was harassed after a moderation case file showed their identity to the reported user, and borderline posts were auto-removed on weak classifier scores. The model-generated draft stores reporter data unredacted and auto-acts below a safe threshold. Review it, fix it, and prove reporter data is isolated and auto-actions need strong evidence.
aiNote: The draft returns the case file to any caller who knows the id, embeds the reporter id and verbatim report text in the response and the action event, and auto-removes content from a 0.6 classifier score with no corroboration.
testIdea: Fetch a case id belonging to another tenant and assert 404; request a case as a non-surveyor and assert no reporter identifiers appear; feed the classifier a 0.7 score and assert the item lands in the human queue instead of auto-removal.
followUps: Who should ever see reporter identity, and under what process?
How would you audit an auto-removal decision after the model version changes?
What queue metrics reveal a moderator working two claims at once?
